validated_objective: Release QIF v0.7.2 with an executable, domain-general missingness and attrition sensitivity model.
scope: Add canonical policy, case-level outcome disposition, sensitivity analysis, and assessment entities.
Extend verifier, schema, example, negative fixtures, authoring guide, roadmap, changelog, runtime log, and portable package.
constraints: Do not impute missing outcomes as observed truth, infer causal missingness, or grant operational authority.
Retain all existing v0.7.1 behavior and example-only boundaries.
expected_outcomes: Every eligible enrollment is classified exactly once and denominator arithmetic is reproducible.
Best-case and worst-case bounds reveal whether unavailable outcomes could change the declared conclusion.
Low coverage, unexplained attrition, or conclusion sensitivity routes governance.
